subject: Payment on hold — VAT ID mismatch causing invoice rejection
body:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Martin Keller <martin.keller@heliosoft.de>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 +0100
Subject: Payment on hold — VAT ID mismatch causing invoice rejection

Hi Martin,

Our collections team flagged invoice INV-3892 (due 2025-09-10) as `Payment on hold` — the EU VAT registry lookup returned a mismatch between the VAT number you provided and the registered legal name/address. The payment gateway is refusing settlement until we have validated documentation.

Can you please:
- Confirm your company VAT/TRN (exact characters including country prefix).
- Send a scanned copy of the VAT registration certificate that clearly shows the VAT number and legal entity name (PDF preferred).
- If your billing name differs from the trading name (e.g., post-merger), include a short attestation on company letterhead explaining the variation.

Attachments: INV-3892-Redwood-2025-09.pdf (invoice stub), required-docs-checklist.pdf (checklist)

If you prefer to avoid further holds, two pragmatic options we can offer:
1) HelioSoft provides an updated VAT certificate — we release full payment once validated.
2) Temporary partial release: Redwood can approve a 50% payment ahead of full validation and hold the remainder until documentation is complete. This reduces operational impact while we clear compliance.

Please let me know which approach you can do and attach the certificate. If you expect a delay, reply with a target date and I will loop in Finance.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Account Manager — EU Enterprise
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0XXX

-----
From: Martin Keller <martin.keller@heliosoft.de>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Sep 2025 11:03:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Payment on hold — VAT ID mismatch causing invoice rejection

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the heads up. I've attached the VAT certificate we normally share (Helio_VAT_certificate_v2019.pdf). That certificate predates our acquisition of NordisTech — legal name on registry is still the legacy entity in some places.

We're in the process of updating the registration info but it may take several business days to propagate across EU registries. We can provide a company attestation on letterhead in the meantime.

Best,
Martin Keller
Head of Finance — HelioSoft GmbH
martin.keller@heliosoft.de
Attachment: Helio_VAT_certificate_v2019.pdf

-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Martin Keller <martin.keller@heliosoft.de>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 08:27:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Payment on hold — VAT ID mismatch causing invoice rejection

Martin — thanks for the quick reply and for sending the certificate.

On Mon, 14 Sep 2025 at 11:03 Martin Keller <martin.keller@heliosoft.de> wrote:
> Hi Monica,
> 
> Thanks for the heads up. I've attached the VAT certificate we normally share (Helio_VAT_certificate_v2019.pdf). That certificate predates our acquisition of NordisTech — legal name on registry is still the legacy entity in some places.

Quick summary / next steps (cc'ing Neha from Billing and Vivek from Finance Ops):
1) Documentation we require to clear the hold:
   - Updated VAT registration showing the VAT/TRN used on the invoice (country prefix + number).
   - If the registry shows the old legal name, a signed attestation on company letterhead indicating the name change and the date of merger.
   - A scanned PDF where the VAT number is legible (mobile photos are fine if high-res).
2) Temporary mitigation we propose to avoid service interruption:
   - Option A: Redwood releases 50% of the outstanding balance immediately; remaining 50% released upon validation.
   - Option B: Helio signs the short self-billing waiver via DocuSign (link below) and we process payment after acceptance.

I have attached a short partial-payment proposal (partial-payment-proposal.xlsx) that shows the amounts and ledger entries our Finance team would use if we do Option A. If you can get any of the three documents above to me by EOD Friday (2025-09-19), we will prioritize clearing the remainder next week.

DocuSign (self-bill): https://docusign.com/recipient/abc123-self-bill
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If Helio prefers, Vivek is happy to take a 10-minute call to confirm the exact wording we need on the attestation. Vivek — can you make a 10:00-10:30 CET slot tomorrow?

Martin — please confirm which option you prefer and attach the attestation/certificate when available.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Account Manager — EU Enterprise
Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +44 20 7946 0XXX

Neha Kapoor

neha.kapoor@redwood.com
